title: monday-task-flow project-config
description: Per-project configuration consumed by monday-task-flow plugin hooks/skills. Lives at .claude/project-config.json in the consumer repo.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when making breaking changes to this schema.

defaultBase.description: Branch name PRs target by default (e.g., 'staging' or 'main').

hotfixBase.description: Branch hotfix PRs target. Usually 'main' even when defaultBase is 'staging'.

branchConvention.description: Template for new branch names. Use <slug> as placeholder.

worktreeRoot.description: Path (relative to repo root) where worktrees live.

autoMergePolicy.description: Per-branch auto-merge policy. Keys are branch names, values are policies.

enabled.description: Whether i18n parity checks run on edit/commit.

defaultLocale.description: Source-of-truth locale (other locales must contain its keys).

parityHookMode.description: How the parity check behaves on missing keys.

requiredChecks.description: CI check names that must be green before merge.

monday.description: Monday-specific configuration. Currently informational only; future versions may use board/column IDs to make the MCP per-project.

extraRules.description: Additional project-specific rule files (in .claude/rules/) to surface. Plugin's universal rules auto-load per rules-routing.json.

hooks.description: Per-project hook activation. Plugin hooks are OPT-IN — list each hook by name to enable it. Hooks not listed here are inert (exit 0 immediately).

enabled.description: Names of plugin hooks active in this project.
